title: incident-bot: surface SLO-toolkit suggested actions in on-call runbook messages
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: On-call responders currently see SLO diagnostics and runbook links but need a curated set of suggested remediation actions surfaced directly in the incident-bot on-call message. This PR integrates the slo-toolkit suggestion engine into the incident-bot pipeline so suggested actions (with runbook links and confidence scores) are shown as quick actions in Slack and in the web on-call UI. Summary of changes: 1) new adapter that translates slo-toolkit suggestion payloads into incident-bot action cards; 2) UI payload changes for Slack blocks and web UI action sections; 3) rate-limiting and deduplication logic to avoid noisy suggestions; 4) telemetry events for suggestion impressions and click-throughs; 5) feature flag (incidentbot.enable_slo_suggestions) and rollout gate; 6) unit, integration and an e2e on-call flow test. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged unless the feature flag is enabled; runbook linking and existing diagnostics remain intact. Security/privacy: suggestions are filtered to avoid exposing internal PII and respect on-call team scoping. Rollout plan: behind feature flag -> opt-in on pilot (platform team) -> 2 week canary -> org-wide on approval. Testing: unit tests for adapter, integration tests with slo-toolkit mock, manual sanity in staging with simulated SLO incidents, e2e test covers Slack action click flow. Related linear tickets: ENG-1987 ENG-2050. Related support ticket: SUP-3421. Checklist: [x] adapter + translation logic implemented [x] Slack block and web UI rendering [x] rate limiting + dedupe [x] telemetry + metrics [x] unit/integration/e2e tests [x] docs update (on-call runbook docs) Notes: kept responses compact to fit Slack block limits; added config knobs for max suggestions and min confidence threshold. For operators: see docs/incident-bot/runbooks.md for feature flag and configuration details.
